title: Disappearing Species

card.teaser: A koala silhouette filled with cooling towers. One image instead of a page of statistics.

summary: A koala silhouette filled with cooling towers. One image instead of a page of statistics.

hero.alt: A poster of a koala silhouette containing cooling towers and smoke.

overview.challenge: Make habitat loss and industrial damage visible to someone walking past a poster.
overview.solution: A koala silhouette with cooling towers and smoke inside it, and negative space to suggest what's already gone.
overview.outcome: One direct image that does the work of a page of statistics.
